title: Asking the way
subtitle: 길 묻기
review: Written by Claude. The Korean and the romanization have not been checked by a Korean speaker. English support only: no Burmese lines were written. Check before recording audio.

categories.desc: Finding a place, and finding out where you are.
cards: Hwajangsiri eodiyeyo?
Where is the toilet?

화장실이 어디예요?

A place + -i or -ga eodiyeyo?: where is…?

Jeogiyo, jihacheollyeogi eodiyeyo?
저기요, 지하철역이 어디예요?
Excuse me, where is the subway station?
I geuncheoe pyeonuijeom isseoyo?
Is there a convenience store near here?

이 근처에 편의점 있어요?

I geuncheoe: near here.

I geuncheoe eunhaeng isseoyo?
이 근처에 은행 있어요?
Is there a bank near here?
Yeogiga eodiyeyo?
Where am I?

여기가 어디예요?

'Where is here?' Show your map as you ask.

Jeogiyo, yeogiga eodiyeyo? Gireul ireosseoyo.
저기요, 여기가 어디예요? 길을 잃었어요.
Excuse me, where am I? I'm lost.
Meoreoyo?
Is it far?

멀어요?

Near: gakkawoyo.

Yeogiseo meoreoyo? — Anieyo, georeoseo o bunieyo.
여기서 멀어요? — 아니에요, 걸어서 오 분이에요.
Is it far from here? — No, five minutes on foot.

categories.desc: The four things you are most likely to be told.
cards: Jjuk gaseyo.
Go straight ahead.

쭉 가세요.

Also: Ttokbaro gaseyo.

I gillo jjuk gaseyo.
이 길로 쭉 가세요.
Go straight along this street.
Oreunjjogeuro gaseyo.
Go right.

오른쪽으로 가세요.

Left: oenjjok.

Daeum sageorieseo oenjjogeuro gaseyo.
다음 사거리에서 왼쪽으로 가세요.
Go left at the next crossroads.
Hoengdanbodoreul geonneoseyo.
Cross at the crossing.

횡단보도를 건너세요.

Hoengdanbodo: pedestrian crossing.

Jeo hoengdanbodoreul geonneoseyo.
저 횡단보도를 건너세요.
Cross at that crossing.
Baro jeogiyeyo.
It's right there.

바로 저기예요.

Baro: right, just.

Ucheguk baro jeogiyeyo. Eunhaeng yeopieyo.
우체국 바로 저기예요. 은행 옆이에요.
The post office is right there. It's next to the bank.

categories.desc: The right train, a ticket, and a taxi.
cards: I jihacheol Gangnam gayo?
Does this train go to Gangnam?

이 지하철 강남 가요?

Ask before you get on.

I beoseu gonghang gayo?
이 버스 공항 가요?
Does this bus go to the airport?
Pyo eodiseo sayo?
Where do I buy a ticket?

표 어디서 사요?

Pyo: ticket.

Jeogiyo, pyo eodiseo sayo? — Jeogiyeyo.
저기요, 표 어디서 사요? — 저기예요.
Excuse me, where do I buy a ticket? — Over there.
Daeum yeogi eodiyeyo?
What is the next station?

다음 역이 어디예요?

Daeum: next. Yeok: station.

Daeum yeogi eodiyeyo? — Sicheongieyo.
다음 역이 어디예요? — 시청이에요.
What is the next station? — City Hall.
Yeogiro ga juseyo.
To this place, please.

여기로 가 주세요.

In a taxi: show the address on your phone.

I jusoro ga juseyo.
이 주소로 가 주세요.
To this address, please.
